props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial checked state (uncontrolled). Default false, from the component source.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback fired when the checked state changes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the row is disabled — both the checkbox and row press handler are disabled. Default false, from the component source.

props.name: children
props.description: Preferred over the legacy label; the row forwards its modes to slot children. Declared: Content rendered in the row's label slot (between the leading and trailing edges). This is the primary way to supply the label and mirrors the Figma "Text" slot — pass a plain string for the default token-styled label, or any custom node(s) for full control. Multiple children are laid out in a horizontal row with `slot/gap` (Figma default `Slot gap = XS` → 2px), matching the `Text` + `Link` composition in the design. A single custom node (e.g. a vertical stack) is left as-is. Custom nodes receive the same `modes` as the parent. When both `children` and the legacy {@link label} prop are provided, `children` wins.

props.name: label
props.description: A string label wraps; the Long label story's name does not mean it truncates. Declared: Deprecated: Prefer the `children` slot instead (`<CheckboxItem>Fixed deposit • 0245</CheckboxItem>`). `label` is kept for backward compatibility and behaves identically — it is used only when no `children` are provided. The label content rendered next to the checkbox.

props.name: control
props.description: With control trailing, the end action comes first and the Checkbox last. Declared: Position of the checkbox control relative to the label. - `'leading'` (default): checkbox is rendered on the left, then label, then optional `endSlot` on the right. - `'trailing'`: optional `endSlot` is rendered on the left, then label, then checkbox on the right (row uses `space-between` so the checkbox sits on the trailing edge). Matches the Figma "Control" variant on the Checkbox Item component. Default "leading", from the component source.

props.name: endSlot
props.description: A press on the end-slot Button does not change the selection; a press on the row toggles it. Declared: Optional content rendered in the row's end slot (e.g. a `Button`). When provided, it receives the same `modes` as the parent. Wrapped in a fixed-width container matching the Figma `endSlot` design. Presses on the end slot do not toggle the checkbox. Placement depends on `control`: - With `control="leading"` the slot appears on the right edge (after the label). - With `control="trailing"` the slot appears on the left edge (before the label).

props.name: endSlotWidth
props.description: Figma's end slot is 80 px, matching the default; the nested Checkbox is 18 px. Declared: Width of the end slot container in pixels. Defaults to 80 to match the Figma reference. Default 80, from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: Design token modes for theming (e.g. `{ 'Color Mode': 'Light' }`).

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for screen readers. Defaults to the `label` prop when it is a string.

modes.name: Color Mode
modes.description: A token collection CheckboxItem reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Context
modes.description: A token collection CheckboxItem reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Slot gap
modes.description: A token collection CheckboxItem reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: Button / Size
modes.description: Not in CheckboxItem's mode list; set in the row's modes, it reaches the end-slot Button, and XS fits the 80 px slot.

slots.name: children
slots.description: Content rendered in the row's label slot (between the leading and trailing edges). This is the primary way to supply the label and mirrors the Figma "Text" slot — pass a plain string for the default token-styled label, or any custom node(s) for full control. Multiple children are laid out in a horizontal row with `slot/gap` (Figma default `Slot gap = XS` → 2px), matching the `Text` + `Link` composition in the design. A single custom node (e.g. a vertical stack) is left as-is. Custom nodes receive the same `modes` as the parent. When both `children` and the legacy {@link label} prop are provided, `children` wins.

slots.name: label
slots.description: The label content rendered next to the checkbox.

slots.name: endSlot
slots.description: Optional content rendered in the row's end slot (e.g. a `Button`). When provided, it receives the same `modes` as the parent. Wrapped in a fixed-width container matching the Figma `endSlot` design. Presses on the end slot do not toggle the checkbox. Placement depends on `control`: - With `control="leading"` the slot appears on the right edge (after the label). - With `control="trailing"` the slot appears on the left edge (before the label).

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: Callback fired when the checked state changes.
